text: 上海小南国(3666.HK)公布，以总代价80万港元出售小南国(香港)餐饮集团有限公司。出售事项的完成已于10月30日(上周五)无条件落实，且毋须任何须事先经股东批准或监管机构核准的先决条件。小南国(香港)现已与该公司毫无关联，且该公司对小南国(香港)不保留任何股权、董事会席位、营运控制权、管理职务、财务承诺或担保。由于严重的营运困难及其精致餐饮及正餐餐厅业务面临的不利经济环境，小南国(香港)的所有餐厅营运已于年2月完全停止。于完成时，并无任何正在进行的餐厅营运，其去年度亏损净额约4800万元人民币。 于今年9月底，小南国(香港)净负债约1.692亿元人
text_en: Shanghai XNG Holdings (3666.HK) announced the sale of Xiaonanguo (Hong Kong) Catering Group Co., Ltd. for a total consideration of HK$800,000. Completion of the disposal was unconditionally implemented on October 30 (last Friday) and was not subject to any conditions precedent requiring prior shareholder approval or regulatory approval. Xiaonanguo (Hong Kong) is now entirely unconnected with the company, and the company retains no equity, board seats, operational control, management positions, financial commitments or guarantees in Xiaonanguo (Hong Kong). Due to severe operational difficulties and the adverse economic environment facing its fine dining and full-service restaurant businesses, all restaurant operations of Xiaonanguo (Hong Kong) had completely ceased in February. At completion, there were no ongoing restaurant operations, and its net loss for last year was approximately RMB 48 million. As of the end of September this year, Xiaonanguo (Hong Kong) had net liabilities of approximately RMB 169.2 million
